name: Chest Lift with Rotation
summary: Hold the Abdominal Curl with the hands behind the head, turn the ribs to one side, come back to centre and turn to the other.
steps: Lie on the back, knees bent, hands behind the head.
Curl the head and shoulders up.
Staying lifted, turn the ribs towards one knee.
Come through centre without lowering and turn to the other side.

layers.title: Stay up
layers.text: Side to side at the same height.

layers.title: Legs in tabletop
layers.text: The pelvis stays still under moving ribs.

cautions.note: Support the head fully in the hands, or keep it down.

cues:
Turn the ribs, not the elbows.
Both sides of the waist stay long.
Pelvis heavy and still.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
